stories.story_fr: Au T1 2026, les actifs sous gestion franchissent le seuil symbolique de 1000 milliards de dollars (1.03 trillion), accompagnant des fee-related earnings records.
stories.story_en: In Q1 2026, assets under management surpassed the symbolic $1 trillion mark ($1.03 trillion), alongside record fee-related earnings.
stories.signal: Franchissement du cap du trillion d'AUM
stories.quote: record fee-related earnings and assets under management surpassing $1 trillion - a testament to the trust our clients place in us and a reminder of the value we create at scale.

stories.story_fr: L'exercice 2025 affiche une activite d'origination record de plus de 300 milliards de dollars et des collectes superieures a 225 milliards, moteur de resultats records sur les fees et les spreads.
stories.story_en: Full-year 2025 delivered record origination activity exceeding $300 billion and inflows of more than $225 billion, driving record fee and spread related earnings.
stories.signal: Machine d'origination et de collecte a plein regime
stories.quote: 2025 highlights include record origination activity exceeding $300 billion and inflows of more than $225 billion, driving record fee and spread related earnings.

stories.story_fr: Apollo se positionne au coeur du financement de la renaissance industrielle, des solutions de retraite et de l'acces des nouveaux investisseurs aux marches prives a grande echelle.
stories.story_en: Apollo positions itself at the forefront of financing the industrial renaissance, retirement solutions, and giving new buyers access to private markets at scale.
stories.quote: Whether financing the industrial renaissance, advancing retirement solutions, or enabling new buyers to access private markets at scale, we are at the forefront of building the next generation of financial services.

stories.story_fr: Apollo met en avant l'origination de credit investment grade, les solutions de retraite et le developpement de nouveaux produits comme les leviers d'innovation et de discipline qui le portent.
stories.story_en: Apollo highlights investment grade credit origination, retirement solutions, and new product development as the innovation-and-discipline levers driving it forward.
stories.quote: Whether we're originating investment grade credit, delivering retirement solutions, or developing new products and capabilities, innovation and discipline continue to drive us forward.
